supersedes_prepared_amendment.reason: The structured semantic tensor contracts, remote unit tests, exact-step guard, source hash gate, and inactive fail-closed submit path have now been validated.

interface_contracts: stance supervision is loss-only and never enters model forward inputs
language receives one differentiable token built from the predicted three-class stance distribution
structured stance gradients propagate through K to the task-relevance logits
zero-UQ structured conditioning is exactly invariant to task relevance
unknown lexical fusions such as prepare_right are rejected by the frozen stance vocabulary

authorized_run.objective: fresh Route196 learnability smoke for the explicit predicted planning-semantics bottleneck

success_policy: Passing every preregistered gate permits only an explicit migration review for the frozen 8-event Stage2-L pilot; it does not make the pilot automatically training-ready.
stop_policy: Exactly one submission, no step extension and no automatic rerun. Failure pauses further Route196 overfit iterations and requires review of the discrete language contract before any pilot training.
claim_boundary: One-event structured semantic architecture learnability smoke only; no held-out generalization, trajectory, closed-loop, or safety evidence.
